name: Gamou Tatsuhiko
source:
The lawyer. 
Despite his youth, he already runs his own private law office and is considered a capable, ambitious man. In business, he maintains a smart, professional demeanor, but having climbed the ranks so young, he is confident, forceful, persuasive, and rather smooth-talking. He is also quite self-assured. Rumor has it he has considerable experience in romance and is well-versed in dealing with women. After graduating from the Imperial University and obtaining his law license, he opened his private office in Yanaka, Tokyo. He serves as the executor of the current inheritance case, sending the letter to the heroine at the instruction of his client, the late Onuma.

"You’ll see right away… from the very start, you were mine."

[Translated from [url=https://pil-vamp.jp/products/aizou/chara]the official website[/url].]
